items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 One of the best game I've ever played. C
items.summary: One of the best game I've ever played. Characters divided into 4 realms/groups, all of it is unique. Old characters are meta, everyone, even SR characters are meta and has unique way of attacking. Strategy forces you to use your brain instead of just observing and then press skill or basic ones like other games. For your information, ALWAYS BRING A SHIELDER, NO NEED FOR HEALERS, yeah you heard it right. Healers isn't very good in this game so I want to see more characters with better healing kit
